outcome_definitions.impression: one surface display of listing title and thumbnail, not a unique human
outcome_definitions.click: an attributable visit from the counted impression on the same store surface and reporting window; click events are not purchases
outcome_definitions.purchase: a verified completed paid transaction with order timestamp, independently measured; not provided by platform impression aggregates

rates.ctr: click_events / impressions on a comparable impression frame
rates.checkout: completed_paid_orders / eligible_checkout_opportunities only when these are measured and reconciled
rates.profit: actual settled receipts minus costs, never infer from ctr

known_risks: feed placement and external referrals vary
owner impressions may include repeat display events
historical seven-day impression collection might differ in the current interface
unmeasured subscriber traffic can shift visits
a clicked thumbnail does not demonstrate payment
